name: Should I relist with my previous agent or choose a new one?

mainEntity.name: Should I relist with my previous agent or choose a new one?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to relist with your previous agent or choose a new one depends on several factors. Consider why the listing expired: was it due to market conditions, pricing, marketing strategy, or communication with your agent? If you were satisfied with your agent's effort but the market was challenging, renegotiating terms might be an option. However, if you feel a change in strategy or approach is needed, interviewing new agents is advisable. Kelby Contreras and Realty ONE Group Evolution bring a fresh perspective and extensive local market knowledge across South Florida, which can be crucial in developing a new strategy for expired listings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assess why your listing expired. If you need a new strategy or improved communication, consider a different agent; otherwise, renegotiate with your current one.
